about.headline: Behind the *build*
paragraphs: **Full-Stack Developer** and **AI/ML Engineer** :spark: building systems that solve ==real problems==, from ==cattle classification== :leaf: for the Rashtriya Gokul Mission to ==mental-health platforms== :heart: for students. **IEEE Code Astraa 2025 finalist** :trophy: presented to ==2,000+== industry stakeholders :mic: at UP International Trade Show 2024.

My work has been presented at **government missions** and **industry events**, which shaped how I approach every project: ==build to ship== :rocket: not just to demo. Currently seeking ==internship opportunities== to build **impactful products** at scale.
about.funLine: I train AI models that help ==real farmers==, build chatbots that calm ==2 AM anxiety==, and craft web apps that ==feel alive==. Slap my code on any problem and act surprised when it **actually ships**.
